name: Hiiragi
source: One of the characters of the Placebo storyline (appears exclusively in the remake's "YUKI" episode). An outgoing freelance journalist interested in the occult. [spoiler]He has psychic abilities and, as an associate of Tokio Morishima, sometimes uses said abilities to perform exorcisms.[/spoiler]
